args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices instead of a fixed schedule.
- Companion piece finding: shippers who split their volume across three carriers (rather than relying on one or two) paid the lowest overall freight costs.
- Takeaway: with spot rates softening and surcharge volatility rising, diversifying carrier mix appears to be the most effective lever for controlling freight spend this quarter.
